crossRefs.note: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret…
Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of…
And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is…
“To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet…
“I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Nathanael
people.line: Disciple of Jesus, from Cana in Galilee.

people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus

translations.web: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
translations.bsb: “How do You know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translations.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
translations.asv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
